posts.preview: The Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication ,  Labour and Industrial Relations has flagged traits of poor labour practices in some mining companies in the country.

A report released by the Justina Jonas  chaired committee released by Parliament last week has recommended that the Ministries of Industries, Mines and Energy (MIME) and Justice and Labour Relations (MoJLR) take urgent, coordinated action to ensure that the mining sector upholds labour rights, promotes local employm...
According to the committee the recommendations also identify areas where Namibian law and regulations need to be amended to align with labour rights obligations.
